title: Design System: Jannyca Ilaida — Programme Bill

display.purpose: The name, two stacked Bodoni spans with text-wrap balance.

title.purpose: Cast values (dd), right-aligned in the programme list.

lead.purpose: The italic line under the name, max 70ch, in Plum Lead.

body.purpose: The quiet sans base; only the small uppercase programme labels use it.

label.purpose: dt programme labels, uppercase with wide tracking, in Rose Deep.

caption.purpose: The portrait figcaption, italic, max 34ch, in Mauve Muted.

script.purpose: The single Great Vibes close line. One cameo only.

shadows.name: bill-lift
shadows.purpose: The programme sheet floating above the stage.

motion.name: ease-expo-out
motion.purpose: The single authored entry easing; every entrance uses it.

motion.name: bill-reveal
motion.purpose: The bill sheet: rise, settle scale, and blur out.

motion.name: name-rise
motion.purpose: Each name span: rise and letterspacing settle (delays 120ms / 220ms).

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Lead (320ms), cast list (420ms), close (620ms): rise with blur-out.

motion.name: photo-reveal
motion.purpose: The portrait arch at 360ms: rise and scale-in.

motion.name: tie
motion.purpose: The bows at 700ms / 760ms: drop, scale-overshoot, and settle.

motion.name: reduce-kill-switch
motion.purpose: The blanket kill switch all new motion must inherit.

components.name: The Programme Bill
components.description: The single arched sheet the whole page is; never a card grid.
components.css: .ds-bill { position: relative; width: 320px; padding: 48px 32px; border-radius: 120px 120px 24px 24px; border: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(159,20,68,0.22)); background: linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 40%, var(--sheen, rgba(255,255,255,0.5)) 50%, transparent 60%), radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, var(--blush, rgba(214,51,108,0.06)) 0%, transparent 46%), var(--paper, #fbf0ee); box-shadow: 0 34px 80px var(--shadow, rgba(159,20,68,0.14)), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.5); } .ds-bill__sample { margin: 0; font-family: 'Bodoni Moda', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink, #25121f); }

components.name: The Name Mast
components.description: The huge Didone name, rose second line, hairline, and italic lead.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-mast__name { margin: 0; display: grid; gap: 0.02em; font-family: 'Bodoni Moda', Georgia, serif; font-size: clamp(3.4rem, 10vw, 6rem); font-weight: 600; line-height: 0.88; letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-wrap: balance; color: var(--ink, #25121f); } .ds-mast__name span { display: block; } .ds-mast__name span:last-child { color: var(--rose, #d6336c); padding-left: clamp(0.4em, 6vw, 1.4em); } .ds-mast__name::after { content: ''; display: block; margin-top: clamp(20px, 3vw, 34px); height: 1px; background: var(--line, rgba(159,20,68,0.22)); } .ds-mast__lead { margin: clamp(28px,4vw,44px) 0 0; max-width: 70ch; font-family: 'Bodoni Moda', Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; font-weight: 500; font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2.2vw, 1.55rem); line-height: 1.5; color: var(--lead, #3a2433); }

components.name: The Cast Row
components.description: The label/value programme rows, hairline-divided, 120px label column.
components.css: .ds-cast { margin: 0; display: grid; } .ds-cast__row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 120px minmax(0,1fr); gap: 18px; align-items: baseline; padding: 18px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(159,20,68,0.22)); } .ds-cast dt { color: var(--rose-deep, #9f1444); font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.22em; } .ds-cast dd { margin: 0; font-family: 'Bodoni Moda', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink, #25121f); text-align: right; }

components.name: The Portrait Arch
components.description: The 4:5 crown-arch photo slot; a real photograph is pending.
components.css: .ds-frame { width: 240px; display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 18px; } .ds-frame__arch { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; border-radius: 200px 200px 26px 26px; border: 1px solid var(--rose, #d6336c); background: linear-gradient(150deg, #fbe3ea, #f3c3d4); box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(159,20,68,0.2), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.5); } .ds-frame__caption { margin: 0; max-width: 34ch; font-family: 'Bodoni Moda', Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--muted, #6b5563); text-align: center; }

narrative.overview:
A theatre program printed for one person. The page is one arched sheet of warm ivory program stock, centered in the viewport, that a visitor reads the way they read a playbill: a name first, a lead line, a cast list, a stage photo. It deliberately refuses the 'three card intro grid'; the whole surface is a single bill, so the visitor reads a name, not a dashboard.

The world is satin and stage light. One committed ballet rose carries the second name line, the hairline rules, the edge of the portrait arch, and a drawn satin bow. Everything else stays on the ivory/plum neutral ground. Type is Didone star voice throughout (Bodoni Moda), with Great Vibes reserved for one small close line. Motion is a single authored entry choreography with exponential ease-out, played once, and annihilated entirely under prefers-reduced-motion. The build is honest about unfinished assets: the arch photo is a labeled placeholder awaiting a real portrait.
keyCharacteristics: One printed sheet, arched at the crown, never a three-card grid.
One committed ballet rose (#d6336c) carries the second name line, the hairlines, the drawn bows, and the portrait-frame edge.
Didone star type (Bodoni Moda) is the only show face; Great Vibes appears exactly once, in the small close line.
Hairline rules only — 1px rose-derived strokes; no heavy borders.
One-shot entry choreography on a single exponential ease-out, with a full prefers-reduced-motion kill switch.
Honest alt text and figcaption on the portrait placeholder; a real photograph is still pending.

rules.name: The Single-Rose Rule
rules.body: One ballet rose family (rose at #d6336c, depth at #9f1444) is the only hue that may leave the ivory/plum neutral ground. Every wash, hairline, sheen, and shadow is derived from it; a second accent hue breaks the printed-bill illusion.

rules.name: The One Cameo Rule
rules.body: Great Vibes appears exactly once, as the small close line. Bodoni is the star voice; the script must never grow into a heading or a second line.

rules.name: The No-Gradient-Text Rule
rules.body: Text is flat ink. Gradients belong to stock and light — washes and sheens — never to letters.

rules.name: The No-Em-Dash Rule
rules.body: Prose uses commas and full stops; the em-dash is barred from the programme voice.

rules.name: The Stage-Light Rule
rules.body: Depth is light, not hard offset shadow. All shadows are rose-tinted and diffuse; surfaces separate with hairlines and sheen, never crisp 3D edges.

rules.name: The Arch Rule
rules.body: Every principal surface (the bill, the portrait frame) opens with a wide crown arch; only the arch and the bows may carry such generous radii. Interior corners stay small (26–36px).

rules.name: The One-Shot Choreography Rule
rules.body: Motion happens once, on entry, and every entrance uses the same exponential ease-out cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). After the choreography plays, the page is still — no hover motion, no loops.

rules.name: The Kill-Switch Rule
rules.body: Every animation must be annihilated under prefers-reduced-motion. The page ships a blanket kill switch (animation: none, transition: none); new motion must inherit it.

dos: Do keep the whole page one sheet; the three-card intro grid is barred.
Do set every rule as a 1px rose hairline (rgba(159, 20, 68, 0.22)); never a solid rose rule or a heavier border.
Do use the exponential ease-out cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) for every entrance.
Do gate every animation behind the prefers-reduced-motion kill switch.
Do write honest alt text and captions when an asset is still a placeholder.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue; ballet rose is the only one (The Single-Rose Rule).
Don't use Great Vibes anywhere but the close line (The One Cameo Rule).
Don't set gradient text or em-dashes (The No-Gradient-Text Rule, The No-Em-Dash Rule).
Don't add hover or looping motion; the choreography plays once on entry and the page is then still.
Don't square off a principal surface; the crown arch is the bill and the portrait frame (The Arch Rule).
